# fflate

Version 0.8.3, upstream tag commit
`a661bab4c135c368b6e68af3be1904f89ed070cf` from
https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate.

`browser.js` is the unmodified `esm/browser.js` published in the official
`fflate-0.8.3.tgz` package (npm SHA-1
`bc27d8eb30343d4d512abb03480202ce65d825fc`). `LICENSE` is its MIT license.

The release web runtime generator retains only the synchronous gzip decoder,
with Tide's own CRC32 and output-length checks. No compression, ZIP or worker
implementation is included in a game. The generated runtime includes the
complete copyright and permission notice.
